b: I don’t know if anyone else does this. But I was struggling to find a good milk situation for my daily lattes. I usually like 4-8oz of milk in them (depending on the mood).
I don’t like buying a whole gallon/half gallon of milk because I’m the only one in my family drinking it, and it goes bad 4 days in.
And the healthy almond milks with no gums/preservatives (like MALK) are 2 x 48oz for $14ish at Costco - which makes 12-24 lattes. (So $0.58-$1.16 per latte).

So … I’ve bought a jar of Costco almond butter for $9ish (24 servings of 2 tbsp). It’s the one where the only ingredient is almonds, so no extra preservatives. A good almond milks ratio is 1 tbsp of almond butter for 8oz of water. Theoretically I could make 48 servings of 8oz almond milk at ~$0.19 per serve. Or 96 servings of 4oz almond milk at ~$0.09 per serve!
Plus almond butter lasts for months in the fridge.
And you can either batch blend for the next few mornings or every morning.
And you don’t have to worry about it going bad as quickly like with whole milk or store bought almond milk.
And if you get tired of making almond milk you can use the almond butter for literally anything else.
And you can flavor it whatever you like.
and you just need a blender, no nut milk bag or machine or ANYTHING
Anyway i hope this helps someone who has the same problem as i did😆
